sql: SELECT b.period_start, b.period_end, b.days, CAST(b.kwh AS DOUBLE) AS kwh, count(CAST(w.TMAX AS DOUBLE) + CAST(w.TMIN AS DOUBLE)) AS weather_days, coalesce(round(sum(greatest((CAST(w.TMAX AS DOUBLE) + CAST(w.TMIN AS DOUBLE)) / 2 - 65, 0)), 1), 0) AS cdd, coalesce(round(sum(greatest(65 - (CAST(w.TMAX AS DOUBLE) + CAST(w.TMIN AS DOUBLE)) / 2, 0)), 1), 0) AS hdd FROM (VALUES (DATE '2025-08-01', DATE '2025-08-31', 30, 1024), (DATE '2025-08-31', DATE '2025-10-01', 31, 847), (DATE '2025-10-01', DATE '2025-10-31', 30, 961), (DATE '2025-10-31', DATE '2025-12-01', 31, 1336), (DATE '2025-12-01', DATE '2025-12-31', 30, 1797), (DATE '2025-12-31', DATE '2026-01-31', 31, 2014), (DATE '2026-01-31', DATE '2026-03-02', 30, 1881), (DATE '2026-03-02', DATE '2026-04-01', 30, 1135), (DATE '2026-04-01', DATE '2026-05-01', 30, 1060)) AS b(period_start, period_end, days, kwh) LEFT JOIN noaa_ncei.cmh_daily_from_2024 w ON to_date(w.DATE) >= b.period_start AND to_date(w.DATE) < b.period_end GROUP BY b.period_start, b.period_end, b.days, b.kwh ORDER BY b.period_start
